idea-plugin.name: DocViewKit Omni
idea-plugin.description:
Preview Office, PDF, OpenDocument, and iWork files without leaving your JetBrains IDE. Documents stay on your device or IDE-managed remote workspace—no uploads and no conversion server.

Open a document

Open a supported file normally. DocViewKit Omni renders it in a read-only editor with navigation, zoom, search, text selection, safe hyperlinks, and interaction modes where supported.

Why DocViewKit Omni?

  • Documents stay private: parsing, rendering, and search run locally. The plugin does not upload documents or send file names and paths to a remote service.
  • No conversion server: preview files without a document-conversion backend.
  • Broad format support, free: view modern and legacy Office, PDF, OpenDocument, Apple iWork, WPS Office, XPS, RTF, and CSV files.
  • Fast and lightweight: format components load on demand for faster startup and lower resource use.
  • Safe, read-only viewing: active document content is not executed, and isolated resource failures do not unnecessarily hide the rest of the document.
  • IDE-native behavior: files load through IntelliJ Platform APIs, refresh when changed, and follow the IDE theme and language.

Supported formats

DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, DOTM, DOC, RTF, WPS; XLSX, XLSM, XLTX, XLTM, XLS, CSV, ET; PPTX, PPTM, PPSX, PPSM, POTX, POTM, PPT, DPS; ODT, OTT, FODT, ODS, OTS, FODS, ODP, OTP, FODP; Pages, Numbers, Keynote; PDF, XPS, and OXPS.

The free Viewer includes every available format and retains DocViewKit branding. DocViewKit Omni is powered by DocViewKit Viewer.
